summary: Iter18 health/regression pass after env fixes (resend installed, .env files created). Backend starts cleanly (/api reachable, LGD/geo startup tasks OK). New pytest suite test_iter18_health_regression.py: 15/15 PASS (passenger/driver login, bad login 401, admin blocked on app login, location search, Bengaluru->Chennai trip search (2 demo trips), trip detail, booking create + bookings list, chat send/get, cancel, notifications, driver earnings/trips/profile, real admin login returns must_change_password=true and /admin/stats 403 until changed, TEST admin forced-change -> stats + 17 admin list endpoints 200). Frontend (Expo web 390x844): language -> auth (OTP off, 'Use email instead') -> passenger login -> Home/Offer/Bookings/Messages/Notifications tabs + Profile load without red errors; search Bengaluru->Chennai via location picker shows '2 rides found'; trip detail renders (status, driver, price, seats, map). Driver login: Offer form, My rides (6 demo rides), More -> Earnings load. Admin: login -> forced /admin/change-password -> dashboard; all 19 admin tabs render. One bug found & fixed: admin dashboard MapDataCard used the app-user api client, so /api/admin/geo/report always 401'd in the admin portal (and could trigger the app user's onUnauthorized logout).

minor.issue: No role filter - lists admins (e.g. 'Travoo Admin') and drivers as passengers; also N+1 (6 queries per user, up to 200 users).
'drivers' uses {driver_status: {$ne: 'not_submitted'}} which also counts users missing the field; 'Passengers' (distinct bookers) vs 'Registered passengers' labels are confusing (1 vs 2 shown).

ui_bugs.issue: Called /admin/geo/* with app-user `api` instead of `adminApi` -> 401 console errors, map database card failed to load. FIXED by tester (import adminApi as api).

issues: 'Earnings by trip' shows 'Publish your first ride to start earning' empty state although the driver has 6 scheduled rides (only trips with bookings are listed) - misleading copy.

action_items: Filter /api/admin/passengers by role (exclude admins/approved drivers or label them) and batch the per-user aggregates
Make admin stats driver count use $nin/['not_submitted', null] and clarify 'Passengers' vs 'Registered passengers' labels
Adjust Earnings 'by trip' empty state copy when driver has published rides without bookings
critical_code_review_comments: (tabs)/_layout.tsx: notifications polling useEffect has no `user` guard (unlike useUnreadMessages) - will fire /notifications every 15s even if signed out
server.py is 3700 lines - should be split into routers

Old regression suite tests/test_travoo_api.py relies on ADMIN_PASSWORD env and a non-forced admin; it now fails at admin fixture because the bootstrap admin must change password first. Use a TEST admin fixture like test_iter18_health_regression.py

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows after MapDataCard fix
